title: Security compliance review prep (1:1) - Nina Shah
content:
Meeting: prep for 1:1 with Priya (compliance lead) / Ryan (audit ops)
Date: 2026-03-06 10:00am PT (tentative)
Location: Zoom / record for notes
Purpose: sync on SOC2/ISO readiness, vendor risk backlog, and immediate audit evidence we need to surface for external auditors.

Background / quick status
- SOC2: control mapping mostly done; still missing evidence for: change management (CH-02), vendor onboarding (VEND-03), and periodic access reviews (AC-05).
- ISO: gap analysis complete, three high-priority items (encryption of backups, asset inventory ownership, patch SLAs).
- Vendor risk: ~18 vendors in high/medium risk queue; 6 outstanding questionnaires (SIG-lite) sent >30 days.
- Upcoming audit window: external auditor onsite week of 2026-04-18; need core evidence uploaded by 2026-04-08.

Agenda (proposed)
1) Quick status (5 min) -- confirm top 3 blockers
2) Evidence sprint plan (15 min) -- who owns what, where to upload, acceptance criteria
3) Vendor risk triage (10 min) -- prioritize top 6 vendors, action on questionnaires
4) SOC2 control owners & missing artifacts (15 min) -- tie each missing control to an owner and deadline
5) Escalations / resources needed (10 min) -- SRE support, infra snapshots, legal sign-offs
6) Next steps & calendar sync (5 min)

Key questions I want to ask / notes to raise
- Change management (CH-02): we say we have GitHub PR + deployment approvals as evidence. Do auditors accept PR history + deployment tickets, or do they want a separate change log export? If export required, who can run one (release-engineering)?
- Access reviews (AC-05): last documented review was 2025-12. Need a plan for quarterly remediation and evidence for March 2026. Who runs the Okta report? (Ryan?)
- Vendor onboarding (VEND-03): For top vendors (DatastoreX, MonitoringCo, ModelOps partner), do we have signed DPA + completed SIG-lite? Several are missing signatures. Legal can expedite DPAs but need list of vendors and POCs.
- Backups encryption (ISO): need confirmation from infra that snapshot encryption at rest is enabled for S3 buckets + on-prem NFS backups. Who owns verifying configuration?

Immediate evidence checklist (what auditors typically request)
- Access control: Okta group membership export, recent access review artifact (CSV/PDF)
- Change mgmt: PR history + deployment ticket exports, change request approvals (if any)
- Logging: central logging retention policy, sample logs showing retention >= 90 days for auth events
- Incident response: postmortem template + 2 recent ops incidents showing use of template and timelines
- Vendor mgmt: vendor inventory CSV, DPA copies, completed SIG-lite questionnaires (PDFs), risk ratings and mitigations
- Encryption: KMS policy, proof of encrypted backups (screenshot + config snippet), key rotation schedule
- Patch mgmt: patch SLA docs and recent patch report showing compliance

Who I propose to assign (draft)
- Access review report: Ryan Kim — due 2026-03-10
- Change mgmt export: Julian (release-engineering) — due 2026-03-09 (ask SRE for help running export)
- Vendor docs aggregation: Priya Desai + Legal (Sam Lee for DPAs) — vendor list & missing items due 2026-03-12
- Encryption confirmation: Casey / infra team (ticket to infra) — due 2026-03-08
- Logging retention proof: Observability team (Avery) — due 2026-03-11

Draft acceptance criteria for evidence (short)
- Single PDF/CSV per control that maps to control ID (e.g., AC-05)
- Timestamped exports or screenshots with dates within last 30 days
- Owner sign-off (email thread or confluence comment) attached

Risks / blockers to call out
- Release engineering bandwidth: they are in a code freeze Feb->Mar for infra work, might not be able to run custom exports quickly.
- Vendor legal: DPAs sometimes take 2+ weeks; need prioritized list so we can escalate with contracts.
- Data location: some backup proofs live in on-prem tooling that infra needs to extract — may add delay.

Preparation TODOs (for me before the meeting)
- Pull current vendor inventory (from Confluence page) and mark which have DPA/SIG on file (quick pass) — due today 2026-03-05
- Draft short email template for vendors to request SIG-lite completion — include legal contact — due today
- Prepare list of control IDs missing evidence with short description (attach to agenda) — due 2026-03-05 EOD

Follow-up / action item template (to capture live in meeting)
- Action: [short description], Owner: [name], Due: [YYYY-MM-DD], Evidence location: [confluence/jira/drive link], Status: [open/in progress/done]

Notes to self (talking points)
- Emphasize audit timeline and need for hard evidence vs statements.
- Ask for a small "evidence upload" working session for 2 days (Mar 23-24) to batch uploads to auditor portal.
- Suggest weekly short standup for audit owners (15 min) between now and 2026-04-08.

Quick links (for meeting)
- Controls inventory (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/SOC2+-+Controls+Inventory
- Vendor inventory (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Vendor+Inventory
- Auditor portal (internal link): https://auditor-portal.internal.redwood.ai
- JIRA filters: JIRA-SEC-*/SEC-PILEDGER (use during meeting)

Misc scribbles / phrases to include in meeting notes
- "Need evidentiary artifacts, not verbal assurances"
- "Prioritize top 6 vendors for legal escalation"
- "Request infra snapshot exports (tagged) + hash"

End of prep doc.

-- Nina

(keep as draft; will clean up and attach to meeting invite)
